c_normalization.reason: Seq calls the fast path only for positive integral steps no greater than 200. Count that long-double value into uintmax_t explicitly so C2Rust need not emit its unsupported long-double-to-uintmax cast.
Use the mechanically counted integral step in the existing decimal increment loop.
Preserve eager cat operation evaluation while avoiding C2Rust's integer-to-bool casts for bool &= bool.
Preserve eager fmt evaluation and accumulate its Boolean status explicitly.
Preserve eager nl_file evaluation and accumulate its Boolean status explicitly.
Preserve eager process_path evaluation and accumulate its Boolean status explicitly.
Always perform the checked decimal multiplication while explicitly accumulating its overflow flag.
Always perform the checked decimal addition while explicitly accumulating its overflow flag.
Always emit every relative-path component while explicitly accumulating output errors.
Make the small multiplier's exact idx_t destination width explicit.
Make the bounded line-counter allowance's exact idx_t width explicit.
Make the relative-path size multiplier's size_t width explicit.
Make the terminating-byte allowance's size_t width explicit.

selection_policy: The next measured-smallest independent canonical archives after batch five. Mknod is deferred because it repeats mkfifo's selinux.c source path and would trigger C2Rust's repeated-source deduplication hazard; pinky is substituted.
